properties.text: The Russian MoD claimed on September 11 that the Russian Eastern Grouping of Forces seized Zorivka (southwest of Oleksandrivka).[59] A Russian servicemember allegedly raised a flag in Zorivka, according to geolocated footage published on September 11.[60] ISW cannot verify with high confidence the reliability of the footage and has reason to assess that the footage splices together multiple video clips.

Ukrainian forces maintain positions in Novodanylivka (south of Orikhiv) in areas where Russian forces previously infiltrated based on geolocated footage published on September 9.[60] A Russian milblogger claimed that Russian forces advanced in central Orikhiv.[61] Ukrainian forces continued their intermediate-range strike campaign in occupied Zaporizhia Oblast.
